name: Suwa Touko
source:
A beautiful, unfortunate maid. While the other maids are merely makeshift maids, she is a genuine maid who has served the Tenkuin family since she was a child. Alone in the world, she feels a deep sense of gratitude towards the head of the family, Yoichiro. By order, she is forced to entrust herself to the protagonist...

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/harameido/]official site[/url]]
